tutorialNudgeRunes: Runes are for later lessons — buy a Dwarf from the shop first.
tutorialNudgePlacePads: Move both Dwarves onto the glowing pads first (one must be rotated).
tutorialNudgeFinishPad: Finish placing on the glowing pad before buying another unit.
tutorialNudgeReadGoal: Click Next when you are ready to end deployment.
tutorialNudgeCameraFirst: Finish the camera lesson first — follow the on-screen steps.
tutorialNudgeRotate: Rotate this pack (press R or middle-click) to match the tall pad.
tutorial1GoalBody: The glowing frames mark each side’s life bar. Yours is on the left, the enemy’s on the right — bring theirs down to 0 to win. Each unit that survives the battle counts and reduces the enemy’s life bar.
tutorial1CamLeftBody: Slide the view to the left so you can see more of the field that way.
tutorial1CamRightBody: Now slide the view to the right.
tutorial1CamForwardBody: Push the view toward the middle of the battlefield.
tutorial1CamForwardTouch: Drag one finger toward the bottom of the screen
tutorial1CamBackBody: Pull the view back toward your side.
tutorial1CamBackTouch: Drag one finger toward the top of the screen
tutorial1CamOrbitBody: Orbit around the field so you can look from a new angle.
tutorial1CamOrbitTouch: Drag with three fingers left or right
tutorial1CamZoomBody: Zoom closer to the board — you will need this when placing packs.
tutorial1Buy1Body: You have 200 supply — enough for two packs. Click the glowing Dwarf in the shop.
tutorial1Place1Body: Click your Dwarf twice to pick it up, then find the glowing pad on the map and click it to place the pack there.
tutorial1Buy2Body: Click the glowing Dwarf again. You will place this one differently.
tutorial1Place2Body: Move the second Dwarf onto the other pad, then rotate it — press R, middle-click, or use the Rotate button on touch — so it matches the tall footprint.
tutorial1EndBody: Press the glowing End Deployment button — the battle then runs automatically.
tutorial2NudgeFinishStep: Complete the current step before ending deployment.
tutorial2NudgeNoShop: This round uses your Stronghold only — no shop packs.
tutorial2R1IntroBody: This is your keep. If it falls, your whole army dies. Click it to open its panel.
tutorial2R1ArchersBody: Buy all {{slots}} archer slots on the battlements — they defend the keep during the battle.
tutorial2R1EndBody: Press End Deployment — the battle runs automatically. Your archers will hold the line.
tutorial2R2IntroBody: This round the enemy sends a bigger wave. Click your Stronghold — you will buy commander spells from it.
tutorial2R2BuyOilBody: Buy Oil Spill from your Stronghold — it slows enemies marching through the center.
tutorial2R2ArmOilBody: Click Oil Spill in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R2PlaceOilStartBody: Click the glowing circle on the left side of the center lane.
tutorial2R2PlaceOilEndBody: Click the glowing circle in the middle of the board to finish a left-to-center oil trail.
tutorial2R2BuyDragonBody: Buy Dragon Attack — it breathes fire across the lane and can ignite the oil.
tutorial2R2ArmDragonBody: Click Dragon Attack in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R2PlaceDragonStartBody: Click the glowing circle on the right side of the center lane.
tutorial2R2PlaceDragonEndBody: Click the glowing circle on the left to finish a full-length right-to-left dragon path.
tutorial2R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — watch the oil slow them and the dragon set the path ablaze.
tutorial2R3IntroBody: Both sides now have a Stronghold. Destroy the enemy keep and their entire army collapses — even if their packs are winning. Click your Stronghold to continue.
tutorial2R3UpgradeBody: Keep upgrading your Stronghold — click Upgrade in the top right corner of the Stronghold panel until it reaches level {{max}} (now {{level}}/{{max}}).
tutorial2R3BuySummonBody: Buy Summon Dwarves from your Stronghold — drop them behind the enemy keep.
tutorial2R3ArmSummonBody: Click Summon Dwarves in your tactics strip to arm it.
tutorial2R3PlaceSummonBody: Click the glowing circle on the right side behind the enemy Stronghold — their army is on the left, so your dwarves hit the keep from the rear.
tutorial2R3UpgradeNudge: Upgrade again — your keep is only level {{level}}/{{max}}.
tutorial2R3EndBody: Press End Deployment — if the enemy Stronghold falls, their whole army dies with it.
tutorial3NudgeReadIntro: Read the briefing and press Next first.
tutorial3NudgeNoShop: No packs this round — the lesson is on the panel to your right.
tutorial3NudgePlacePads: Put your Dwarves on the left pad and your Ballista on the right pad first.
tutorial3NudgeBoosts: Max both Vanguard boosts first — attack {{attack}}/{{max}}, HP {{hp}}/{{max}}.
tutorial4NudgeRunes: Buy at least {{need}} runes first — you have {{bought}}.
tutorial4NudgeLongbow: Buy Range on your Archers first — that is the only talent this round.
tutorial3R1IntroBody: Knock a tower down and that side’s units crawl, hit weaker, and take more damage.
tutorial3R1BuyDwarfBody: Click the glowing Dwarf in the shop — they will hold the left lane against the enemy packs.
tutorial3R1PlaceDwarfBody: Click the pack twice to pick it up, then click the glowing pad on the left so it meets the enemy Dwarves head-on.
tutorial3R1BuyBallistaBody: Click the glowing Ballista. It out-ranges everything on the field — perfect for an undefended tower.
tutorial3R1PlaceBallistaBody: Place the Ballista on the glowing pad on the right, where nothing stands between it and the enemy tower.
tutorial3R1DebuffBody: Your Dwarves pin their army on the left while the Ballista knocks down the tower nobody is guarding. The moment it falls their whole army reels — and your Dwarves win the lane they were losing.
tutorial3R1EndBody: Press End Deployment and watch the tower come down.
tutorial3R2IntroBody: Identical armies — the only thing that can decide it is what you buy from your Vanguard.
tutorial3R2SelectBody: Click your Vanguard — the tower on your right — to open its panel.
tutorial3R2AttackBody: Buy the Army Attack Boost until it is maxed ({{tier}}/{{max}}). Every tier is permanent and applies to your whole army for the rest of the match.
tutorial3R2HpBody: Now buy the Army HP Boost to the top ({{tier}}/{{max}}). Tougher packs survive long enough for the extra damage to matter.
tutorial3R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — the same pack, boosted twice over, should walk through theirs.
tutorial4R1IntroBody: Both sides already stand nose to nose — two Dwarf packs and three Archer packs, mirrored and locked in place. You cannot move them. The only play is runes.
tutorial4R1RunesBody: Buy base runes from the glowing row in the shop — Earth, Fire, Water and Wind. Get at least {{need}} of them ({{bought}}/{{need}} so far).
tutorial4R1EquipBody: Drag a rune from your bag onto a pack — or arm it and click the pack — to fill its two rune slots. Earth adds HP, Fire adds attack, Water a little of both, Wind adds range. Slotted so far: {{applied}}.
tutorial4R1EndBody: Press End Deployment — runed packs against bare ones is the whole lesson.
tutorial4R2IntroBody: No buildings. {{packs}} Archer packs stand in each side’s center — far enough apart that both lines must march before they can shoot. Range decides who fires first.
tutorial4R2SelectBody: Click any of your Archer packs to open its talent panel.
tutorial4R2LongbowBody: Buy the Range talent — it stretches every Archer pack’s range. That is the only purchase this round.
tutorial4R2EndBody: Press End Deployment — with the longer reach your Archers should open fire first and win the volley.
